The '''Witch Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be [[Tailoring#Hats|tailored]] using [[Cloth]] and a [[Golden Pumpkin]] at the sewing machine inside [[2 Willow Lane|Emily's house]] or the [[Sewing Machine]] received as a reward for the [[Quests#Rock Rejuvenation|"Rock Rejuvenation"]] special order.

There is a small chance to receive this hat from slaying [[monsters]], breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]], chopping [[trees]], shaking trees with seeds, digging [[Artifact Spot]]s, or by [[Pans|panning]].<ref name="rarecosmeticdrop" />
